effect.mna_attributes.spell_might.descri: Increases spell damage by +2 per level.
effect.mna_attributes.spell_frailty.desc: Decreases spell damage by -2 per level.
effect.mna_attributes.spell_preserving.d: Increases spell efficiency by 10% per level.
effect.mna_attributes.spell_wasting.desc: Decreases spell efficiency by 10% per level.
effect.mna_attributes.spell_longevity.de: Increases spell effect duration by 10% per level.
effect.mna_attributes.spell_shortness.de: Decreases spell effect duration by 10% per level.
effect.mna_attributes.spell_haste.descri: Increases cast speed by 10% per level.
effect.mna_attributes.spell_fatigue.desc: Decreases cast speed by 10% per level.
attribute.name.mna_attributes.max_mana.d: Increases your mana capacity by a flat amount.
attribute.name.mna_attributes.max_mana_m: Increases your mana capacity by a percentage. Does not stack with flat Max Mana bonus.
Increases your mana capacity by a percentage. This bonus is calculated after flat Max Mana and Max Mana Multiplier bonuses have been applied.
attribute.name.mna_attributes.mana_regen: Determines how fast you regenerate mana. This value divides the time it takes to refill your mana from empty to full, where higher values mean faster mana regen.
attribute.name.mna_attributes.cast_speed: Determines how long your cooldown is after casting a spell. This value divides your base spell cooldowns, where higher values means faster cooldowns.
attribute.name.mna_attributes.spell_effi: Multiplies your mana costs when casting spells. Values above 1 decrease the cost, values below 1 increase it.
attribute.name.mna_attributes.spell_dama: Increases all spell-related damage values by a flat amount.
Increases all spell-related damage values by a percentage. Stacks multiplicatively with flat Spell Damage.
attribute.name.mna_attributes.spell_dura: Increases all spell-related effect durations by a percentage. Does not apply to most spell shape durations (exceptions are Summon and Wall shapes).
attribute.name.mna_attributes.affinity_a: Decreases mana cost of arcane affinity spells. Increases mana cost of ender spells equally.
attribute.name.mna_attributes.affinity_e: Decreases mana cost of earth affinity spells. Increases mana cost of air spells equally.
Decreases mana cost of ender affinity spells. Increases mana cost of arcane spells equally.
attribute.name.mna_attributes.affinity_f: Decreases mana cost of fire affinity spells. Increases mana cost of water spells equally.
attribute.name.mna_attributes.affinity_w: Decreases mana cost of water affinity spells. Increases mana cost of fire spells equally.
Decreases mana cost of wind affinity spells. Increases mana cost of earth spells equally.
